content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02079 If the configured ComSignalDataInvalidValue is received for at least one group signal of a signal group and the ComDataInvalidAction is configured to NOTIFY for this signal group, the AUTOSAR COM module shall notify the users (e.g. RTE, Sw CluC) via the configured <ComUser_CbkInv> function. In this case, no other signal group / group signal processing like the normal indication shall take place.
